page.layout: One centred title block in roman and italic type, with a printed device (woodcut) below it, and the imprint at the foot. No margins, no running head, no page number.

main_text.l: tissimi Theologi D. PETRI MARTYRIS VER
MILII divinarum literarum professoris in scho-
la Tigurina, habita ibidem à JOSIA
ITEM Scripta quaedam D. Petri Martyris de
HIS accesserunt Carmina doctorum aliquot virorum

page.notes: The handwritten "2" at the top right is a later annotation and is left out. The device is a woodcut of a palm tree in an oval, with its ring inscription partly read: the top arc and the vertical sides are uncertain, so [?] marks them, and the reading of the date on the side is doubtful. The italic line "HIS" is printed in a form close to M; read as HIS, with a doubt. The title lines were set with long s and the printed hyphens kept as printed.
